description:
[Game reference] One monument with its loot sources. The same fields as `/monuments` for one monument plus `loot_sources`: every crate/NPC loot table that
spawns at it (`id`, `name`, `drop_count`), alphabetical - fetch each with `/loot-tables/{id}` - and
`placements`: what the game's monument scenes put there, one entry per layout (most monuments have one):
`recyclers` (`type` recycler/safe_zone/red, `count`, `efficiency_pct`, `seconds`), `vending` (NPC shops: `shop`,
`order_set` - see /vending - and `title`), `cctv` (camera ids for the Computer Station) and `crates` (`name`,
`source_id` for /loot-tables/{id}, `expected` = average number present with spawns filled, `spawn_points`).
Cached for one hour.
name: get_monument
title: One monument with its loot sources
